chitchat: "Door holds. That's my whole job, and I'm good at it."
"Cold crawl in, warm room waiting. Best trade in the Basin."
"If it got through that door, it got through me first. It didn't."
description: A broad, easy-shouldered man on a stool beside the blast door, a lever-action carbine across his knees and a mug of something hot at his elbow. He has the settled watchfulness of a man who has held this exact spot for years and expects to hold it for years more.

bye.text: "Go on in. You're safe here." He settles back onto his stool.

door.text: "That door only opens for people the Watch have squared with. You're standing inside it, so that's you now." He nods at the dark beyond. "Out there the machine's got eyes in every wire. In here it's got nothing. No cameras, no cops, no record you were ever here. Heat on you? Sit a while. It cools faster down here than anywhere in the Basin. That's the point of the place."

kept.text: Pike nods at the stool as you pass, which he does now, and did not before.

rite_accept.text:
He stands, stretches something that clicks, and takes the mug off you rather than handing it over.

"I will keep this warm."

options.label: Where do I get a charge?

rite_offer.text:
"Right." Pike puts the mug down, which you have not seen before.

"Everyone thinks the rite is the sitting. It is not. Anybody can sit. I have sat for eleven years and it has never once been difficult, it has only ever been long."

"The rite is that you have been sat here long enough to know exactly where to put your hands. And then you go and put them there."

He tells you the rest of it flatly, the way you would read out a list.

"The vats. Not the Spire, not the man at the top, not the money — the vats, because that is where they keep the thing they are actually selling, and every single person who has ever said yes to them said yes to that room. Bring the colonnade down."

"And the woman at the gate. Ives. She has been pricing our people for six years and she is very good at it, and she is the reason two of the names on that wall are on that wall. On your way out."

He looks at you properly for the first time in all of this.

"Then come home. That is not decoration. Three of us have done this and one came back."

rite_report.text:
Pike is on the stool when you come down the stair, which means he has been on it the whole time, which means he did not sleep either.

He looks at the state of you. He looks at the door behind you. Then he looks back down the wash, out of habit, and asks the only question the Watch has ever asked anybody.

"Anything?"

And you tell him: no. Nothing behind you. Nothing following.

He nods once and moves along the bench to make room, and that is the whole of it, and it is more than it looks.

options.label: I want to stand the watch.

root.text: The big man lifts his mug in greeting without getting up. "Welcome in. Pike." He tips his head at the sealed door behind you. "You made it past that, so you're one of ours, which means you can finally put your back to a wall and mean it. Warm stove's through in the commons."

sit_accept.text: "Do not open the door. If something comes down the wash you watch it come, and you write the time, and you do not open the door."

sit_offer.text:
"Somebody has to sit the Blind while somebody else sleeps." He says it the way you would mention weather. "Mirror looks down the wash. Shortwave talks to itself. The whole of the job is that you are there and you are awake."

"I have sat it about ten thousand times. I will not thank you for it, and neither will anyone else, and that is not rudeness. It is just that somebody sitting there is the ordinary state of things."

sit_report.text: He takes the stool back without ceremony. "Anything?" You say no. "Good," says Pike, and means it.

teach.text:
"Teach." Pike considers the mug rather than you. "I can show you two things and they are the same thing twice. How to stand for a long time without it costing you anything, and how to breathe while you do it."

He shifts on the stool, which is the most he has moved since you came in.

"That is not modesty. Everybody who has ever lasted down here started with those two, and most of what comes after is people dressing them up. `train body`, or `train breath`. Bring the rest of it to somebody who has seen more than a door."

options.label: I need to think about it.

rite_charge.text:
"The Quartermaster has one on the counter. She has had one on the counter since the day you walked in, and she will not look at you while you pick it up, and you are not to hold that against her."

"You wire it, you set the fuse yourself, and the fuse is the only part of this that is your business and nobody else's. Short and you are running. Long and somebody finds it."

clothing_layers: a cable-knit jumper the colour of wet slate

name: Pike
